id: The Hobbit: The Desolation of Smaug (2013)

facts.text: I've smuggled dwarves in barrels before. Tonight there's fish for supper and not much else.
facts.why: Bard smuggles the dwarves into Lake-town in fish barrels for the first time. He has not done it before, so 'before' is wrong.
facts.fix: Dwarves in the barrels and fish on top. Say nothing at the gate. Supper is fish.

fix_note.text: Dwarves in the barrels and fish on top. Say nothing at the gate. Supper is fish.

vibe.verdict: Barrels, Mirkwood and Beorn are the right picks and the market feels right, but the big finish at Smaug is thin.
